faq.title: Help center
faq.description: Answers to common questions about planning, accounts, calculations, and support.
items: Who is FinAdvisor for?
FinAdvisor is for small-business owners, accountants, and investors. The planning tools currently focus on restaurant businesses in Uzbekistan.
Who performs financial calculations?
The finance engine performs calculations from the information you provide. AI can explain supplied results but does not calculate or invent figures.
Does a business plan guarantee a bank loan?
No. A plan helps organize information for review, but each lender independently decides whether to offer financing.
What should I prepare before creating a plan?
Prepare the business format and location, menu or service description, staffing, equipment, operating costs, and financing goals. Use documented sources for amounts.
Is FinAdvisor personalized financial, tax, or legal advice?
No. FinAdvisor is a planning tool and does not replace advice from qualified financial, tax, or legal professionals.
Which interface languages are available?
The interface is available in Uzbek, Russian, and English. Choose a language from the site header.
How much do subscriptions cost?
The current weekly prices are Free at $0, Pro at $10, and Business at $20. Subscription prices are in USD.
Are monthly and yearly prices final?
No. Monthly and yearly prices are placeholders pending the product decision. The pricing page marks these amounts accordingly.
How many plans can I save?
Plan limits depend on the subscription tier and are enforced by the service. Check the pricing page for the current plan comparison.
Can an accountant use the workspace?
Yes. The accountant role provides accounting access for the assigned business. Account permissions are enforced by the service.
How does the investor marketplace work?
Business owners can choose to publish a project listing. Investors can browse published information and contact an owner through the platform.
Are marketplace listings independently verified?
No. Listing content and funding requests are supplied by business owners and are not independently verified. No investment outcome is guaranteed.
Are tax rules and rates guaranteed to be current?
Tax information is shown with its source and verification status. Unverified information is presented as an estimate; confirm current requirements with a qualified professional.
How is my account and business information handled?
FinAdvisor processes information to provide requested product features. See the draft privacy notice for the current data description; it still requires legal review.
How can I get help or share feedback?
Use the contact form to reach support, or use the feedback button while signed in to the product.
